files.purpose:
Tool approval boundary tests over the wire protocol.

CoderAI emits ``ApprovalRequest`` for shell execution; the client answers
with ``approve`` / ``reject`` / ``approve_for_session`` and the turn runs to
a terminal ``finished`` status. Assertions target the live event shapes
(``tool_call_id`` / ``sender`` linkage).

definitions.name: test_shell_approval_approve
definitions.contract: Approving a Shell call lets the turn finish; request links the tool call.

definitions.name: test_shell_approval_reject
definitions.contract: Rejecting a Shell call still ends the turn cleanly.

definitions.name: test_approve_for_session
definitions.contract: ``approve_for_session`` is accepted; each turn still reports approval.

definitions.name: test_yolo_skips_approval
definitions.contract: ``--yolo`` runs non-shell tools without emitting approval requests.

definitions.name: test_unknown_tool_tolerated
definitions.contract: An unknown scripted tool name does not break the turn.

definitions.name: test_default_agent_tools_available
definitions.contract: The default agent exposes its bundled tools without approval blocks.

files.purpose:
Wire protocol tests for auth-related error handling.

Uses the ``error:`` scripted-echo DSL directive to simulate provider-level
HTTP errors (401, 429, connection, timeout) and verifies they surface
correctly through the wire protocol as provider errors (code -32003).

definitions.name: test_provider_401_without_oauth_surfaces_error
definitions.contract: A 401 from a non-OAuth provider should surface as a wire error.

definitions.name: test_provider_connection_error_surfaces
definitions.contract:
A simulated connection error is retried; the turn recovers afterwards.

CoderAI retries transient provider errors, so the scripted error is
consumed and the follow-up script completes the turn instead of the
turn collapsing into a wire error.

definitions.name: test_provider_500_surfaces_error
definitions.contract: A 500 from the provider is retried; the turn recovers afterwards.

files.purpose: Wire-driven configuration tests: inline config strings and CLI model overrides.

definitions.name: test_config_string
definitions.contract:
An inline JSON config string is accepted at startup.

The initialize handshake succeeds against the inline config. CoderAI
resolves the prompt-time LLM from the config file layer, so the turn
itself may report LLM-not-set; either outcome proves the inline config
path was parsed without a startup crash.

definitions.name: test_model_override
definitions.contract:
``--model`` overrides ``default_model`` from the config file.

Both models use the scripted echo provider with distinct scripts; the
selected model drives the turn to completion.

definitions.name: test_max_steps_reached

definitions.name: test_status_update_fields

definitions.name: test_concurrent_prompt_error

definitions.name: test_continue_session_appends

target live wire behavior: handshake command entries plus terminal turn
statuses.

definitions.name: test_mcp_config_missing_server_file

definitions.name: test_steer_no_active_turn
definitions.contract: Steer without an active turn returns INVALID_STATE.

definitions.name: test_steer_during_active_turn
definitions.contract:
Steer during an active turn returns 'steered' and the model sees
the instruction in the next step.

definitions.name: test_steer_basic_lifecycle_completes
definitions.contract:
Verify that a turn completes normally when a steer could theoretically
be injected.  The scripted provider returns immediately so the steer
window is effectively zero — this test only confirms the lifecycle is
sound, not that the steer is consumed.
